page: Amazon Web Services r9g.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the arm64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, each core operates with a single thread, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. The network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 34 Gbps.

Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the r9g.16xlarge offers secure and lightweight virtualization. The custom Arm-based architecture provides qualitative cost efficiency by delivering high memory density and dedicated core performance with lower power consumption compared to traditional x86 architectures.

This hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caches, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM capacity alongside dedicated Arm-based compute resources.
